$comment: Probed and verified against the live services. Regenerate with scripts/verify-layers when that exists; do not hand-edit URLs without re-probing.

cadastre_lot.name: Lot (NSW DCDB)
cadastre_lot.$format_note: f=geojson returns HTTP 503 on this server (f=json works). Query Esri JSON and convert client-side.
cadastre_lot.cors: sends access-control-allow-origin for the requesting origin

cadastre_property.name: Property (NSW DCDB)
cadastre_property.$status: not yet used — propertyId resolution lands with the site service (build plan step 1)

address_point.name: AddressPoint (NSW Geocoded Addressing Theme)
address_point.$query_note: address values are UPPERCASE, formatted '<number> <street> <suburb>'. A prefix LIKE 'X%' answers in ~0.2s; an embedded wildcard ('X%Y%') defeats the index and took 12s. Prefix only.
address_point.cors: sends access-control-allow-origin for the requesting origin

geocoder.$note: Replaced Mapbox forward geocoding on 2026-09-09. Suggestions come from the NSW address layer above, so a picked result is a real NSW address point rather than an approximate match. The propertyId link still comes with the site service (build plan step 1); the lot is currently resolved spatially by intersecting the address point with the cadastre.
